patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Lusha and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than Lusha's shape. Workflow advantage: Lusha leans contact-management; 6sense leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences.; 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote .
- Workflow coverage skew: Lusha-leaning contact-management vs 6sense-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over.; 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Lusha if you actually need 6sense's motion (Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
